detailed.headline: Strong river-condition anomaly at Pra Mid-Lower Reach
detailed.explanation: On 2026-09-02 the satellite sediment indicator at Pra Mid-Lower Reach (P04) read +0.117. Given the season, recent rainfall and upstream conditions, +0.108 would have been expected — the reading is 2.8 standard deviations above that. Rainfall over the preceding 7 days totalled 16 mm, which is drier than normal for this time of year. The signal has persisted across 2 consecutive observation(s). Observation quality is ACCEPTABLE; overall confidence is high. This indicates unusual surface-water conditions that may warrant investigation. It does not identify a cause, and it does not demonstrate mining activity or the presence of any specific contaminant.
detailed.recommended_action: Field verification recommended at Pra Mid-Lower Reach. Check raw-water turbidity records at the downstream abstraction and inspect the reach between the upstream station and this one for visible disturbance.
